name: HiveOps
tagline: Agents triage incidents, find root causes, test fixes in a sandbox and wait for human approval.
problem: Incident resolution is slow and manual.
solution: A coordinator splits incidents into subtasks for specialist agents, runs remediation in a sandbox and keeps a human approval step and audit log.
demo_moment: Team-described: an incident flows to a proposed fix awaiting approval.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best use of Hex API” among 212 submissions.
Keeps a human approval before changes.

lessons: Sandbox plus approval makes agentic ops acceptable.
